issue_context.title: loadEnv overrides mode env file
issue_context.body:
### Describe the bug

in this case. when i have a `.env` file
```shell
VITE_APP_BASE_ROUTE=/
VITE_APP_BASE_URL=$VITE_APP_BASE_ROUTE
```

and when i build for some mode . i will add `.env.mode` like `.env.production`

```shell
VITE_APP_BASE_ROUTE=/app/
```

i should get the result like this:

```typescript
{
   VITE_APP_BASE_ROUTE: "/app/",
   VITE_APP_BASE_URL: "/app/"
}
```

but vite give the result:

```typescript
{
   VITE_APP_BASE_ROUTE: "/app/",
   VITE_APP_BASE_URL: "/"
}
```

i think it is a error result. when i use the `vue-cli` . its result is right and nature

https://github.com/vuejs/vue-cli/blob/8b5ab227627a3bfbea31b24364f060154a9b0b89/packages/%40vue/cli-service/lib/Service.js#L101-L121



### Reproduction

review_comments: I just realized @sapphi-red suggested the previous code before 😅 I think it's a matter of taste. I don't have a hard preference for this suggestion.

Sorry, I just noticed `VITE_*` env variables cannot be used in `.env`.
```env
# .env
VITE_FOO=$VITE_BAR
```
```shell
VITE_BAR=bar vite dev
```
I don't know about it. But I noticed that this wasn't working from before and should be done while fixing #6626.
